tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lha lnga'i sgrub dkyil mar me mdzad kyi zhal

lung zhes bya ba bzhugs so// bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lha lnga'i sgrub dkyil mar me mdzad dpal ye shes kyi zhal lung zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang mgon po 'jam pa'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo// mun pa'i mdog can sa 'dzin ni// mtshams sprin gzhon nus legs 'khyud lta'i// sku can mkha' 'gro ma'i dbang phyug /khrag 'thung dpal zhabs spyi bos mchod// dbang thob cing dam tshig la gnas pa'i sgrub pa pos/ rgyud nas gsungs pa ji lta ba'i gnas su phyag bdar byas par dri la sogs pas chag chag gdab/ rab gnas dang ldan pa'i bris sku'i mdun du mchod gtor bshams/ nang mchod a mṛ tas sbags pa/ ḍā ma ru/ rdor dril la sogs pa'i yo byad 'du byas/ stan bde bar 'khod la/ nangs par tho rangs bsam gtan gyi yan lag gis 'khod nas/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig /sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig /sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /nye ring chags sdang gnyis dang bral ba'i btang snyoms chen po la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig / ces tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgoms/ de nas phung po la sogs pa'i nga rgyal bskyed par bya ste/ rang gi gzugs kyi phung po ni rnam par snang mdzad do// tshor ba'i phung po ni rin chen 'byung ldan no// 'du shes kyi phung po ni snang ba mtha' yas so// 'du byed kyi phung po ni don yod grub pa'o// rnam par shes pa'i phung po ni rdo rje sems dpa' 'o// de dag thams cad kyi bdag nyid du gyur pa ni dpal he ru ka'o// mig gnyis la ni sa'i snying po'o// rna ba gnyis la ni phyag na rdo rje'o// sna la ni nam mkha'i snying po'o// kha la ni spyan ras gzigs so// lus la ni sgrib pa rnam par sel ba'o// skye mched thams cad la ni dbang phyug rdo rje'o// sa'i khams ni sangs rgyas spyan ma'o| |chu'i khams ni mā ma kī'o// me'i khams ni gos dkar mo'o// rlung gi khams ni dam tshig sgrol ma'o// nam mkha'i khams ni pad+ma dra ba can no// de ltar phung po dang*/

khams dang*/ skye mched rnams lha'i rnam par dag pa'o// rang nyid skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa yab yum du gsal bar gyur par bsams/ nang mchod/ khaṇ+ḍa ro he 'am/ khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi sngags kyis bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu lta bu ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du kaṃ las mi mgo skam po gsum gyi sgyed pu'i steng du/ a las thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba'i nang du dbus dang phyogs bzhir/ bi mū ra shu ma las bdud rtsi lnga dang*/ go ku da ha na las sha rnam pa lngar gsal ba'i kha chod la a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ yaṃ las rlung g.yos/ raṃ las me 'bar/ thod pa'i nang gi rdzas khol te rang gi spyi bo dang mgrin pa snying ga rnams 'od kyi dkar dmar sngon por khol/ slar yang snying ga'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsi rnam pa sna tshogs pa bkug ste/ rdo rje dang zla ba yang zhu nas/ dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa dbyer med du gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum brjod/ mchod pa bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las thod pa'i nang du hūm̐ re re yongs su gyur pa las/ mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsi'i mchod sprin dwangs shing thogs pa med pa he ru ka 'khor bcas dgyes pa bskyed nus par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ ā lo kaṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shapad| sngon 'gro'i gtor ma nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba yak+ṣa/ rāk+ṣa sa/ bhū ta/ pre ta/ pi shā tsā/ un+mā da/ a pa sma ra ḍā ka ḍā ki n+ya dā ya i maṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇan+tu/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ ma ma sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tshan+tu/

ya the baṃ/ ya thaiṣ+ṭaṃ/ bhuñdza tha/ pi ba tha/ dzi gh+ra tha/ mā ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba kārta ya sat+su khaṃ bi shud+dha ya sa hā yi kaṃ bha wan+tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhing skyong chen po brgyad rnams dang*// mkha' 'gro sum cu rtsa gnyis sogs// ma lus 'khor bcas 'dir byon la// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di longs la// sgrub po bdag dang yon bdag la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal pa bzang*// longs spyod 'byor ba kun thob cing*| |zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs// dngos grub kun gyi stongs grogs mdzod// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod// dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// nor dang 'bru rnams 'phel bar mdzod// bde legs thams cad grub pa dang*// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog / ces gtor ma dbul/ de nas/ rang he ru kar gsal ba'i snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros te khams gsum pa'i bgegs thams cad bskrad/ 'od de tshur 'dus pa las bdag nyid khams gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i khro bo sku mdog mthing nag /zhal gsum/ phyag drug /rtsa zhal mthing ga /g.yas ljang*/ g.yon ser/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgyas rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang snang gi rig ma la 'khyud pa/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang thod pa/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis lcags kyu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ phyag rgya lnga dang ldan par gsal ba'i zhal nas/ oṃ suṃ bha ni suṃ bha ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇā pa ya gṛh+ṇā pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya hoḥ bha ga wān bid+yā rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa'i sngags bzhi/ shar/ byang*/ nub/

lhor/ spros shing bkod pa'i yig 'bru rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje'i gur dang*/ dra ba dang*/ bla bre dang*/ rdo rje'i sa gzhir gyur pa dang lhan cig bgegs ma song ba rnams kyi spyi bor phur bu btab cing rdo rje'i tho bas brdungs pas rnam pa kun tu bgegs dang bral bar gyur/ oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ kī la ya kī la ya sarba pā paṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ badz+ra kī la ya badz+ra dha ro ā dzñā pa ya ti/ sarba bigh+nāṃ kā ya wāka tsit+ta badz+ra kī la ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod/ de nas/ rang gi snying gar zla ba'i steng gi hūm̐ gi 'od kyis bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems rnams spyan drangs la/ de 'od du zhu ba bde mchog lha lnga'i bdag nyid du mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ nas/ shapad 'i bar gyis mchod/ he ru ka dpal dpa' bo che// rnam dag rdo rje dbang phyug dang*// rjes chags chags pa che rnams kyi// rdo rje phag mo de la 'dud// phyogs bzhi'i 'dab ma la bzhugs pa'i// mkha' 'gro ma dang lā ma dang*| |dum skyes ma dang gzugs can ma// mkha' 'gro chen mo bzhi la 'dud// ces bstod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// nas/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog gi bar lan gsum gyis bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags/ tshogs zhing rnams rang nyid la thim par bsams/ de nas/ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ phyi nang gis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad snang ba med pa rnam par dag pa nam mkha' rnam par dag pa nyid du gyur/ ces ye shes kyi tshogs bsags/ 'od gsal de'i ngang las/ yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu lta bu yaṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum pa raṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po baṃ gyis mtshan pa/

de'i steng du laṃ las dbang chen sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi pa laṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du ri'i rgyal po ri rab zur bzhi pa rin chen sna bzhi'i rang bzhin can grwa brgyad kyis nye bar mdzes par byas pa/ spro na/ de'i steng du dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma'i dbus su/ sna tshogs rdo rje phyogs kyi mdog can gyi lte bar bh+rūṃ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su paṃ las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ zhes sbyar te/ jo bos bcu gsum mar gzhal yas khang sogs gsungs la/ mi spro na/ jo bo chen pos bde mchog lha lnga dang gtso rkyang ste sgrub thabs gnyis kar dur khrod dang gzhal yas khang ma gsungs pas mi dgos so// de ltar nges par byas nas/ gzhal yas khang sogs mi byed na/ de'i steng du paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa lte ba ge sar dang bcas pa/ de'i steng du thabs kyi rang bzhin zla ba las ā di/ shes rab kyi rang bzhin nyi ma la kā di/ de'i steng du hūm̐ mthing ga rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin can 'od zer lnga 'phro ba dang 'du ba dang bcas pa'o// de thams cad yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka sku dang rtsa zhal du ba dang mun pa chen po ltar rab tu nag pa/ zhal g.yon ljang*/ rgyab dmar/ g.yas ser ba/ zhal rnam par 'gyur ba/ spyan gsum gsum mnga' zhing*/ mche ba bzhi bzhi gtsigs shing 'jigs par byed pa/ phyag dang po gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa thugs kar bsnol bas yum la 'khyud pa/ gnyis pa gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa brgyangs te na bzar 'phyang ba/ g.yas gsum pa na ḍā ma ru/ bzhi pa na dgra sta/ lnga pa na gri gug /drug pa na mdung rtse gsum/ g.yon gsum pa na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /bzhi pa na thod pa/ lnga pa na rdo rje'i zhags pa/ drug pa na tshangs pa'i mgo bo bsnams pa/

zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas 'jigs byed nag po dang*/ g.yon bskums pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo mnan pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs la zla ba phyed pa dang sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i cod pan can/ dpral bar rdo rje'i phreng ba 'dzin pa/ thod pa skam po lnga'i cod pan/ mi rus kyi rna cha dang*/ gdu bu dang*/ mgul rgyan dang*/ spyi gtsug gi nor bu dang*/ mchod phyir thogs pa ste phyag rgya lnga dang*/ thal chen gyis byugs pa ste/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug dag pa'i phyir phyag rgya drug gis rgyas btab pa/ mi'i rgyu mar sbrel ba'i mi mgo rlon pa'i do shal 'phyang zhing stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ sgeg pa la sogs pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ de'i spyan sngar yum sku mdog dmar mo/ zhal gcig /spyan gsum/ phyag gnyis ma/ gcer bu skra grol ba/ thod pa'i dum bu'i ska rags can/ phyag g.yon pas gdug pa la sogs pa'i khrag gis bkang ba'i thod pa bsnams nas yab la 'khyud pa/ g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pas phyogs thams cad 'jigs par byed pa'i rang bzhin can gyi sdigs mdzub can/ bskal pa'i me lta bu'i gzi brjid mnga' ba/ khrag la dgyes shing zhal nas khrag 'dzag pa| byin pa gnyis kyis legs par 'khyud pa bde ba chen po'i bdag nyid can no// phyogs bzhi'i 'dab ma la/ mdun du mkha' 'gro ma nag mo/ g.yon du lā ma ljang gu/ rgyab tu dum skyes ma dmar mo/ g.yas su gzugs can ma ser mo bzhi ga'ang dngos grub ster ba ste zhal gcig /phyag g.yas dang pos ḍā ma ru/ gnyis pas gri gug /g.yon dang pos kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /gnyis pas thod pa bsnams pa/ spyan gsum gsum mnga' zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ gcer bu skra grol ba dpral bar rdo rje'i phreng ba dang phyag rgya lngas rgyas btab pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs g.yon bskums pas ro'i gdan la gnas pa/ mtshams kyi 'dab ma bzhir byang chub sems kyis gang ba'i snod bzhi dang ldan pa'o// de nas sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa ni/

de dag gi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūm̐ nag pos mtshan pa/ de gsum las 'od zer 'phros te/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi ye shes bskul yi ge gsum la so sor thim par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sarba bī ra yo gi nī kā ya wāka tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes nga rgyal brtan par bya'o// de nas go cha bgo ba ni/ he ru ka'i snying kar oṃ ha dkar po/ mgo bo la na ma hi ser po/ spyi gtsug tu swā hā hu dmar po/ phrag pa gnyis su bau ṣaṭa he nag po/ mig gnyis su huṃ hūm̐ hoḥdamar ser/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa haṃ ljang gu/ yum gyi lte bar oṃ baṃ dmar po/ snying gar haṃ yoṃ sngon po/ khar hrīṃ moṃ dkar po/ mgo bor hriṃ hrīṃ ser po/ spyi gtsug tu huṃ hūm̐ ljang gu/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha rnams kyis mtshan par gyur pa ra bsam pa ni go cha bgo ba'o// ye shes sems dpa' spyan drang ba ni/ rkang pa g.yas brkyangs kyis mthe bos mthe bo mnan/ lag pa'i mdzub mo mdud/ mthe bong dang gung mo so sor sbyar/ gzhan rnams sgreng ba 'bar ba'i rgya smin mtshams su g.yon du bskor mig gyen du ldog pas/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ḍā ki nī dzā la sam+ba ra pheṃ pheṃ/ zhes brjod pas/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod pas/ dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa gnyis su med par gyur/ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes nga rgyal brtan/ snying ga'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis dbang gi lha rigs lnga bde bar gshegs pa'i tshogs mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo ste phyi mchod/ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra pañtsa a mṛ ta pū dza pra tīts+tsha hūm̐/ zhes nang mchod/

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa pū dza pra tīts+tsha hūm̐/ zhes gsang mchod 'bul/ chos sku nam mkha' lta bur dbyer med kyang*// gzugs sku 'ja' tshon ji bzhin so sor bkra// thabs dang shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pa// rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod pa ste/ jo bo'i gzhung du/ phyi nang gsang ba gsum gyis mchod cing bstod nas gsol ba btab ste/ zhes pa tsam las ma byung bas 'dir kha bskangs te sbyar ba yin no// de nas/ byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas la| |ji ltar mchog gnyis gsol mdzad ltar// bdag kyang bsrung ba'i don gyi phyir// nam mkha'i rdo rjes bdag la stsol// ces gsol ba btab ste/ mi bskyod pa gtso bor gyur pa'i thugs ka nas mkha' 'gro ma sogs bzhis ye shes kyi bum pa thogs pa byung nas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis kyang*// de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis| |de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol// zhes brjod cing dbang bskur ba dang*/ gtso bo mi bskyod pas kyang*/ rdo rje chen pos dbang bskur ba// khams gsum pa yis phyag byas pa'i| |sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi// gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya// zhes brjod cing dbang bskur bas lus kyi phyi dang nang gi dri ma thams cad dag /dbang yongs su tshar nas dbang rtags su lha thams cad kyi dbu la mi bskyod pa sngon po sa gnon gyi phyag rgya can rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa re res dbu brgyan par gyur

par bsam/ de ltar ci gnas su bsgom mo// skabs 'dir jo bo rje'i sgrub thabs bcu gsum ma dang lha lnga gnyis kar mchod bstod ma gsungs pas ma byas kyang chad pa'i skyon ni med la/ spro na/ oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ shapad 'i bar sbyar ba dang*/ oṃ badz+ra wī ṇi huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ waṃ she= mṛ taṃ ge= mu rañdze= hā s+ya= lā s+ya= gī ti= nṛ t+yai= puṣ+pe= dhū pe= dī pe= oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ rū pa badz+ri huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ra sa badz+ri= spar+she badz+ri= oṃ dharma dhā tu badz+ri huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ lha thams cad kyi ljags hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje dkar po'i rnam pa can gyi sbu gus bdud rtsi drangs te gsol bar gyur par mos te/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ| ḍā ki nī dzā la sam+ba raṃ swā hā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ḍā ki nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ lā me huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro he huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ rū pi ṇī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes lag g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis thigs gtor dbul/ bcom ldan 'das yab yum dga' ba brtsams te snyoms par zhugs pas lha thams cad zag med kyi bde bas tshim par gyur par bsam/ mchod bya mchod byed mchod pa ste 'khor gsum rnam par mi rtog pa'i don la blo bzhag /de ltar phyi nang gsang ba de kho nas mchod la/ rdor dril dang bcas pas/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te bī re shā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ma hā kalpāg+ni saṃ ni bha ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ dzā ṭa ma ku ṭot+ka ṭā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ daṃ ṣ+ṭ+wā ka ra lo gra bhi ṣa ṇa mu khā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ sa ha sra bhu dza bhā su rā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ pa ra shu pā shod+yā ta shū la kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dhā ri ṇe huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/

oṃ byā gh+rā dzi nāṃ wa ra dha rā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ma hā dhū mrān+dha kā ra wa pu ṣā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa ti badz+ra wā rā hī baṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na mo ār+ya a pa rā dzi te trai lokya mā te ma hā bīd+ye shwa ri huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na maḥsarba bhū ta bha yā wa he ma hā badz+re huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na mo badz+ra ā sa ne a dzi te a pa rā dzi te wa sh+yaṃ ka ri ni tra bh+rā ma ṇi huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na maḥsho ṣa ṇi ro ṣa ṇi kro dha ni ka rā li ni huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na maḥtrā sa ni mā ra ṇi pra bhe da ni a pa rā dza ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na mo bi dza ye dzam+bha ni s+t+wam+bha ni mo ha ni huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na mo badz+ra wā rā hī ma hā yo gi nī kā me shwa ri kha ge huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ ces bstod/ de nas bzlas pa bya ba ni/ jo bos bcu gsum ma dang lha lnga gnyis kar bzlas pa'i dmigs pa ma gsungs pas/ lha'i bskyed rim kho na la sems gtad nas bzla bar dgongs sam snyam la/ yang de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs kyi bzlas pa'i skabs su/ rang he ru ka'i thugs kar ye shes sems dpa'| de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'/ de'i thugs kar yi ge hūm̐ sngon po la sngags kyis bskor ba la sems gtad de bzlas pa byas bar gsungs pa ltar/ 'dir yang sbyar du rung bar sems so// bzla bya'i sngags ni/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ḍā ki nī dzā la sam+ba raṃ swā hā/ yab kyi snying po'o// oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ yab kyi nye snying ngo*// oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ yum gyi snying po'o| | oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ yum gyi nye snying ngo*// oṃ ḍā ki nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ lā me huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro he huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ rū pi ṇī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/

phyogs kyi lha mo bzhi'i'o// de ltar sngags kyi skyon yon shes pas ji tsam du bla ma'i man ngag gis bzla'o// de nas rdzogs rim la 'jug par 'dod na/ zla ba pho nya'i lam pa dang*// nyi ma lus kyi dkyil 'khor te// thig le bzhi ni ye shes yin// yongs su dag pa 'od gsal te// dper na nam mkha'i mtshan nyid do// rang bzhin med pa gzugs khams te// dpe chen rnam pa gsum gyis bstan// bskyed dang rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni// rnal 'byor pa yi lam du 'khyer/ /zhes pa lha lnga'i gzhung 'di nyid du gsungs pa'i don bsgom/ yang na/ khams gsum thams cad 'od kyi rang bzhin du byas te/ 'od zer de yang rim gyis bsdus te 'khor la thim/ de he ru ka yab yum la thim/ de snying ga'i hūm̐ la thim/ de zhabs kyu nas nā da'i bar du bsdus la 'od gsal bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngang la ji srid gnas kyi bar du bsgom/ de las yang lus dub/ sems skyo na/ 'od gsal de'i ngang las/ lha lnga po zung 'jug gi skur langs te/ snang la rang bzhin med pa me long gi gzugs brnyan lta bu kha dog dang bcas pa 'ja' tshon lta bu/ sgro skur dang bral ba chu zla lta bur langs te/ zung 'jug tu bsgom mo// zhes jo bo'i dpa' gcig sgrub thabs su gsungs pa la/ 'dir 'khor la thim zhes pa bcug /gzhan de kho na ltar byas pas 'di nyams su blang ngo*// thun mthar/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis rten rnams mkha' 'gro ma bzhi la thim/ de zhal bzhi la/ yum yab la/ yab kyi phyag tha ma rnams rtsa ba'i phyag gnyis la/ zhal lhag ma gsum rtsa ba'i zhal la thim nas/ he ru ka zhal gcig pa/ phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin par gyur par mos la thun mtshams kyi spyod lam la 'jug go// de ltar thun bzhir bsam pa'i thun snga ma gsum la ni gong ltar bya zhing*/ tha ma'i thun la ni/ skad cig ma'i dkyil 'khor du lha rnams la dbang bskur ba dang*/

bdud rtsi dang*/ bstod pa byas la bsgom pa dang*/ bzlas pa bya/ mthar he ru ka'i yi ge brgya pas bzod par gsol zhing*/ oṃ/ badz+ra muḥ zhes ye shes sems dpa' gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig sems dpa' dkyil 'khor rnams rang gi snying khar bsdus la 'od gsal gyi ngang du nyal/ nangs par ni sngar bshad pa thams cad bya'o/ */ thun bzhi so so'i mjug gi thun tha ma'i mthar gtor ma gtang ba ni/ snod gas chag med par gtor ma sha chang sgog btsong la phug 'khur ba la sogs pa khu ba dang g.yos sbyar gyi zas sna tshogs pas sbags pa/ dar gyi rgyal mtshan dang ba dan la sogs pas brgyan pa gnyis stegs khar bsham/ chu chang nang mchod bran nas/ sngar bshad pa'i nang mchod byin rlabs ltar byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi mdun du dam tshig pa'i dkyil 'khor dpal he ru ka rten dang brten par bcas pa/ phyogs skyong 'gro ba rigs drug gi tshogs dang bcas pa skad cig gis gsal bar gyur pa'i phyogs skyong rigs drug gi sems can dang bcas pa yang dpa' bo dang dpa' mo'i rnam par gyur par mos pa sgrub thabs kyi spyan drang ba'i skabs ltar rkang pa dang phyag rgya sngags dang bcas pas/ gtor mgron ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor gzhal yas khang dur khrod dang bcas pa dpag tu med pa nam mkha' dang sa gzhi khebs pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ rig ma bcu drug gis mchod/ bstod pa gang rung gis bstod cing*/ yan lag bdun pa byas te/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gtor mgron ye shes pa'i tshogs rnams dam tshig pa la thim pas gnyis su med par gyur par bsam/ gtor ma dbul ba ni/ mgron rnams kyi ljags hūm̐ dkar po las byung ba'i 'od kyis rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa'i rnam pa can gyi sbu gus gtor ma gsol bas mnyes shing tshim par gyur par mos la/ rdor thal kha phye ba'i rgyas/ oṃ ā ral+li hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ dṛ sh+ya hoḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐/

zhes lan lngas phyogs g.yon skor dang mtshams g.yas skor du phul/ srid dang zhi bar kun nas chags pa'i kun rtog rlabs bcom zhing*// dngos su dngos po ma lus mkha' dang 'dra bar gzigs mdzad pa// thugs rje'i chu ches lci ba thugs kyi pad+ma rgyas mgon dang*// lha mo rnams ni bdag la brtse bar mdzad cing mdzod// ces gsol ba btab/ de nas dur khrod brgyad la dbul ba ni/ phyag rgya snga ma lta bus/ oṃ kha kha sogs lan bdun brjod/ de nas ma mo dang*/ zhing skyong dang*/ phyogs skyong dang*/ dkyil 'khor ba'i srung ma rnams la dam bsgrag par bya ste/ oṃ/ shing gcig dang ni dur khrod dang*// ri bo dang ni ri sul dang*// grong dang bzhi mdo nyid dang ni// khyad par du ni khang stong dang*// gdol pa'i gnas dang thang dang ni// khyad par du ni chur gnas kun// he ru ka dpal bka' 'di yis// thams cad ma lus 'dir 'dus shig /oṃ k+ṣe tra pā la sa pa ri wā ra hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes bkug pas phyogs mtshams su pad+ma'i gdan la 'khod par gyur/ rdor thal kha phye bas/ oṃ k+ṣe tra pā la sa pa ri wā ra ma da na pañtsa a mṛ ta i maṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa sa sarba satwa nāṃ/ shān+ta te tsa tak+ṣe ṇa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis 'bul/ slar yang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhing skyong chen po brgyad rnams dang*// zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun grub mdzod// ces pa'i bar sngon 'gro'i gtor ma'i skabs ltar brjod/ de nas 'jig rten pa rnams la/ chos rnams sgyu ma lta bu ste// dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med// gzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las las yang dag byung*// rdo rje sems dpa' me long bzhin| |der ni gsal dag rnyog pa med// sangs rgyas kun bdag rang nyid ni// bu khyod kyis ni snying la zhugs// rang bzhin med cing gnas med par// chos rnams de ltar shes nas su| |sems can don ni mnyam med byos// skyob pa rnams kyi sras su skye//

zhes chos bshad/ mchod bstod bsdus pa byas nas/ he ru ka'i yi ge brgya pas bzod par gsol/ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes rnams lnga 'dod kor gyis mnyes par byas nas/ mthe bong dang srin lag se gol brdab cing*/ oṃ/ badz+ra muḥ gtor mgron 'jig rten pa rnams rang rang gi gnas su gshegs/ ye shes pa rnams rang nyid la thim par gyur par bsam/ gtor ma'i cho ga bgyis 'dis bdag la ni// bsod nams gang skyes de las 'gro ba kun// myur bar rtog pa'i dra ba yongs bsal zhing*// 'khor lo gsum gyi ngo bor 'gyur bar shog /shes rab bsrungs pa snying rje'i rjes 'gro zhing*// bla ma'i zhabs kyi 'dam skyes la gus pa// bdag kyang skye ba dang ni skye ba ru| |rdo rje theg pa yis ni grol bar shog /sems can thams cad sdig med cing*// sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /rang lam nyid nas grol ba'o// sangs rgyas nyid dang 'phrad par shog /ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral ba dang*// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol// da lta nyid du rjes brtse bas// rnal 'byor bstan bcos gnas la dgod// ces smon lam btab bo/ gtor ma gtsang sar phul lo// smon lam 'di ni thun so sor bsdu ba'i mjug rnams su yang*/ rim gnyis zab mo bsgoms 'dis bdag la ni// zhes bsgyur la smon lam du gdab bo// yang tshes bcu'i mchod pa dang 'di nyid kyi sgo nas slob ma rjes su 'dzin na/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor bkram/ bum pa gnyis mgul chings dang bcas pa chu gtsang la bum rdzas nyer lnga btab pa/ rnam rgyal shar sgo'i g.yas dang las bum g.yon du bshams/ 'bras bu can gyi shing gis kha brgyan/ bum mtshan rnam rgyal la chos 'byung gi lte bar pad nyi rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa/ las bum la sna tshogs pad nyi gri gug bri/ rnam rgyal gyi steng du thod pa'am dung chos dri chus bkang ba'i steng du rdo rje la me tog gi srad bu btags pa bkod/

dkyil 'khor gyi mthar g.yon skor du chu bzhi nyer spyod mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog dang bcas pa mthong brgyud ltar bshams/ bum bskyed ni/ sgrub thabs kyi thun bsdu ba'i phyag gnyis pa rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin par gyur/ ces pa'i rjes su/ bum pa gnyis bsangs sbyangs| stong pa'i ngang las baṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i bum pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa kha rgyan mgul chings dang bcas pa lha'i chu bos gang ba gnyis kyi rnam rgyal bum pa'i nang du paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa lte ba ge sar dang bcas pa/ de'i steng du thabs kyi rang bzhin zhes pa nas/ snod bzhi dang ldan pa'o// zhes pa'i bar dang*/ las bum gyi nang du pad nyi ro'i gdan la pāṃ las gri gug pāṃ gyis mtshan pa las dum skyes ma dmar mo dngos grub ster ba ste/ zhal gcig pa/ zhes pa nas/ ro'i gdan la gnas pa/ zhes pa'i bar sngar mkha' 'gro ma bzhi'i skabs ltar sbyar nas/ de rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ zhes pa nas/ rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa re res dbu brgyan par gyur gyi bar bya/ mchod pa sngar ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ chos dbyings dag pa'i rang bzhin las// sgyu ma ji bzhin mchod yon mas// spros bral bum pa'i lha tshogs mchod// dgyes nas dngos grub rab tu stsol// oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du chu bzhi nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas par sngags tshig sbyar/ rig ma bcu drug gi sngags rgyas mchod nas/ rdor dril 'dzin pas/ he ru ka dpal dpa' bo che// rnam dag rdo rje dbang phyug dang*| |rjes chags chags pa che rnams kyi// rdo rje phag mo de la 'dud// phyogs bzhi'i 'dab ma la bzhugs pa// mkha' 'gro ma dang lā ma dang*// dum skyes ma dang gzugs can ma// mkha' 'gro chen mo bzhi la 'dud// dbang gi las dang dga' bral dang*// chos rjes dran pa'i ngo bo nyid// sku mdog dmar po drag shul can// khaṇ+ḍa ro he la phyag 'tshal//

zhes bstod/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od spros/ bum nang gi lha rnams kyi thugs kar phog pas lha rnams snyoms 'jug mdzad pa'i sbyor mtshams nas bdud rtsi bab pas bum pa gang bar gyur par dmigs/ yum dang mkha' 'gro ma bzhi'i sngags ci 'grub bzla/ mthar gzung thag las bum khar spos/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro he sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes kyang bzla/ de nas/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes rnam rgyal steng gi dri'i chu rnam rgyal gyi lhar mchod yon du phul/ hūm̐ bdun brjod/ lha rnams 'dod chags chen por zhu ba bum chu dang ro gcig tu gyur par bsam/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ las bum la/ las thams cad pas 'dir dbang ngam/ rab gnas la sogs pa'i bya ba ma grub kyi bar du bgegs la sogs pa bsrung bar mdzod cig / ces brjod/ mdun gyi dkyil 'khor bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu lta bu/ zhes pa nas/ mdzes par byas pa/ de'i steng du dur khrod chen po brgyad kyi nas/ gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su paṃ las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ zhes pa nas/ rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa re res dbu brgyan par gyur pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar sbyar la/ khyad par ni/ sgrub thabs su dur khrod dang gzhal yas khang yod med gang bde la/ 'dir de dag nges par sbyar ro// de nas mchod pa sngar ltar byin gyis brlabs/

rdo rje mtshan ldan dung chen por// rdo rje mchod yon mtha' yas pa// rdo rje sngags kyis rab sbyangs te// rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul// oṃ shrī he ru ka tsakra sam+ba ra sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ.ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ shapad 'i bar sbyar/ rdo rje lha mo sngo ser ma// ljang gu pi wang gling bu rnga// rdza rnga mtha' gnyis rdor dril 'dzin// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro mchod// oṃ badz+ra wī ṇi waṃ she mṛ taṃ ge mu rañdze huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ bzhad sgeg glu gar lha mo ni/ */dmar sngo ser ljang rang rang nyams/ */ mtha' gnyis thod pa cang te'u 'khrol// gsang ba mchog gi dgyes par rol/ */oṃ badz+ra hā s+ya lā s+ya gī ti nṛ t+yai huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ dkar mthing dmar ljang rig ma bzhi| |me tog bdug spos mar me dri// mtha' ma cang te'u g.yon gnyis na// thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ 'dzin pas mchod// oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe dī pe gan+dhe huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ gzugs dang ro dang reg chos dbyings| |g.yas pa rang rtags cang te'u dang*// g.yon gnyis thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ 'dzin// dkar dmar ljang dkar lha mos mchod// oṃ rū pa ra sa spar+she dharma dhā tu badz+ri huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces dang*/ gzhan yang 'dod lnga rgyal srid bdun la sogs pas mchod/ nang mchod ni/ rnal 'byor ma bzhis sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i thod pa thogs te dkyil 'khor pa rnams la mchod par gyur par bsam/ nang mchod thogs la/ hūm̐ */ snod ni thabs kyi rang bzhin te// mtshan ldan yi dwags lhung bzed du// bcud ni shes rab rang bzhin te// bdud rtsi lnga dang sgron ma lnga// sbyangs spel sbar bas bdud rtsi'i mchog |'chi med bcud chen dam rdzas 'di// rtsa brgyud bla ma'i zhal du 'bul// pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/ 'khor lo bde mchog zhal du 'bul/ pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/ rdo rje phag mo'i zhal du 'bul| pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/ mkha' 'gro bzhi'i zhal du 'bul/

pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/ dam can rgya mtsho'i zhal du 'bul/ pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/ zhes pas gtor mar sgron cing myang*/ gsang mchod ni/ bcom ldan 'das yab yum 'khyud pa dang*/ zhu ba dang*/ mnye ba dang*/ tsum+ba na dang*/ rdo rje pad+mar reg pa dang*/ snyoms par 'jug pa bsrubs shing bsrub pa dang*/ byang sems 'pho med du bcings pas zag pa med pa'i bde ba chen po sbar bas lha thams cad kyang zag pa med kyi bde bas tshim par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes 'khyud rgya bya/ de kho na'i mchod pa ni/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma ṇāṃ ād+ya nut+pan+na twāta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes 'khor gsum dmigs med du bzhag /bstod pa ni/ rdor dril dang bcas pas/ hūm̐ */ mkha' ltar dag pa'i chos kyi dbyings// dmigs med snying rje'i rang gdangs ni// khro med khro bo'i skur bstan pa// rdo rje khrag 'thung dpal la 'dud// rnam par 'gyur ba'i zhal mnga' zhing*// bcu gnyis phyag gis mtshon cha gdengs// zhabs gnyis 'jigs dus gdan la bsgyings// nag po che la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /mi rus phyag rgya drug 'dzin cing*/ */mi yi rgyu mas rab sbrel ba'i// mgo rlon khrag 'dzag do shal can// 'jigs med gar dgu ldan la 'dud// bcu gnyis spyan dmar 'khrugs shing zlum// mche ba bcu drug rno dkar ldan| |stag lpags rlon pa'i mthang gos can// drag po che la bdag 'dud do// de nyid dgyes bde rnal 'byor ma// dmar mo khro chags brtse nyams can// khrag la dga' zhing khrag 'dzag ma| |rdo rje phag mo de la 'dud// gcer bu thod dum ska rags can// phyag g.yon khrag bcas thod pa thogs// g.yas pa sdigs mdzub rdo rje yis// gdug can sdigs par byed la 'dud| |khams bzhi dag pa lha mo bzhi// nag ljang dmar ser nam mkha'i gos// cang te'u gri gug kha ṭ+wāṃ thod// phyag rgya lnga ldan de la bstod// bstod par 'os pa thams cad la// zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi// lus btud pa yis rnam kun tu// mchog tu dad pas bstod par bgyi//

zhes bstod/ lha rnams la dmigs nas so so'i bzlas pa ci 'grub bya/ de rjes 'das pa dang 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma sgrub thabs ltar dbul/ skabs 'dir 'og nas 'byung ba ltar bdag 'jug blang*/ sems can thams cad la dngos grub thams cad kyi bka' drin stsol cig / ces gsol ba btab bo// slob ma gzhug pa ni/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i slob ma khrus bya/ gral la 'khod/ me tog bkram/ maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ bu khyod su yin ci la dga'// zhes dri/ slob mas/ skal bzang bdag bde ba chen po la'o// zhes lan gdab/ oṃ tsak+ṣurbahan+dha wa ra mā na ya hūm̐/ gdong bcings/ a khaṃ bī ra hūm̐/ me tog gtad/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste// slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol// byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa// mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo// dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol// byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon pos bdag ni gzhug par 'tshal// lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa mi dge so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir| |byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas// sems can thams cad bdag gis mgron du gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog / gsum gyis lnga rnam dag bya/ slob ma'i snying gar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla dkyil gyi dbus su don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pas mtshan par bsam/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pā da yā mi/

zhes slob mas brjod/ brtan phyir rdo rje me tog slob ma'i snying gar gtug / oṃ su ra te sa ma ya s+t+waṃ hoḥ sid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes slob dpon gyis brjod/ sangs rgyas sras bcas thams cad dang*// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun// bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol| |bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas ni// dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su// byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i| |byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrim gsum// bdag gis brtan por gzung bar bgyi// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// deng nas brtsams te gzung bar bgyi// nam du yang ni mi spong ngo*// rdo rje'i rigs mchog chen po la// rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang*// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi| |rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba'i// pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la// phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos ni gzung bar bgyi// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// bla na med pa'i byang chub sems// dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung*// ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol// dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god//

gsum gyis sdom pa gzung*/ rdo rje mgor bzhag / deng khyod la de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyis byin gyis rlob kyi/ de'i mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir gzhan ma zhugs pa rnams la khyod ma smra zhig */ma dad pa rnams la yang ngo*// zhes spyir gsang bar gdams/ hūm̐ dzaḥhūm̐/ zhes yol ba'i nang du bcug /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// slob dpon la ni skyabs su mchi| |dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma 'khor lo// rnal 'byor gnas la bdag phyag 'tshal// zhes phyag bya/ rdo rje mgor bzhag / deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi rigs su zhugs kyi/ des na ngas khyod la ye shes rdo rje bskyed kyi/ ye shes gang gis khyod sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob kyi/ dngos grub gzhan lta ci smos/ khyod kyis kyang dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i mdun du tshul 'di smra bar mi bya ste/ byas na khyod dam tshig nyams pa yin no// zhes phan yon dang*/ rdo rje snying gar bzhag nas/ oṃ/ de ring 'khor lo sdom pa ni// khyod kyi snying la 'jug mod kyi| |tshul 'di gzhan la smras pa na// de ma thag tu dral te gshegs// zhes nyes dmigs dang*/ bdud rtsi sbyin zhing*/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ste// dam las 'das na sreg byed pa'i// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'thung zhig /oṃ pañtsa a mṛ ta u da ka ṭha ṭha ṭhaḥ zhes gnyis kas rdo rje lag tu gtad/ deng nas bzung ste khyod kyi 'khor lo sdom pa nga yin gyi/ ngas 'di gyis shig ces gang bsgo ba khyod kyis bya dgos so// khyod kyis nga la brnyas par yang mi bya ste/ khyod ya nga ba ma spangs par shi nas rdo rje'i dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur ro// zhes slob dpon bka' gnyan pa'i sgo nas dam la bzhag /byin dbab pa ni/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs la/ dpal he ru ka bdag la dbab tu gsol/

gsum gsol/ slob ma skad cig gis 'khor lo sdom par gsal ba'i rkang mthil du yaṃ/ lte bar aṃ/ snying gar hūm̐/ mgrin par oṃ/ spyi bor haṃ rnams gsal ba'i yaṃ las rlung g.yos/ aṃ las me sbar/ hūm̐ dang oṃ bsregs/ haṃ las byang sems bab pas bde ba'i aṃ gi me'i drod kyis lus sems yul snang thams cad bde stong gi ye shes su thim zhing*/ slar snying ga'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis 'khor lo lnga'i lha thams cad skad cig gis bkug /slob ma'i ba spu'i khung bu thams cad du bcug pas thim par gyur par bsam/ sbyar ba'i spos bdug /rol mo dang bcas/ oṃ shrī he ru ka sarba bī ra yo gi nī badz+ra ā we sha ya s+t+waṃ bha ya to ṣa ya to ṣa ya/ ra ra ra ra/ tsa la ya tsa la ya/ a a aḥ zhes dbab/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra dang rdo rje rgya gram gyis brtan par bya/ me tog thogs nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ hūm̐ dzaḥhūm̐/ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra ho/ zhes dkyil 'khor du dor/ lha'i gtsug tor la mchog /zhal spyan sngags/ sku stod dngos grub chen po/ bar 'bring*/ smad tha/ sku la nye na dngos grub myur/ ring na ring*/ lha gnyis kyi bar du na gang nye de/ mnyam na gang mos/ rtsig pa'i phyir lhung na lan gsum bskyar/ yang bskyar der lhung dngos grub phra mo/ rdor ra'i phyir lhung la dngos grub med par lung bstan/ oṃ pra ti gṛh+ṇa s+t+waṃ i maṃ sa twa ma hā ba la/ zhes me tog de nyid slob ma'i mgor bcing / oṃ nai tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa laṃ hrīḥ zhes mig dbye/ rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams rim gyis bstan to// rdo rje slob ma'i dbang la maṇ+ḍal dbul/ byang chub rdo rjes gsol ba btab/ slob dpon 'khor lo sdom par gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis slob ma bkug pa slob dpon gyi zhal du bcug /thugs kar rjes chags 'od gsal gyi mes bsregs sku'i dbyibs brgyud mkha' gsang du bab pa 'khor lo sdom pa'i rnam par gyur te mdun du spros/

dbang rdzas lnga dang slob ma'i phung sogs bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i gdan la dbang rdzas bum chu dang slob ma'i rnam shes kyi phung po hūm̐ dang rdo rje las zhe sdang rdo rje nag po g.yas rdo rje/ dbu rgyan dang slob ma'i tshor phung aṃ dang rin po che las nga rgyal rdo rje ser po g.yas rin po che/ rdo rje dang slob ma'i 'du shes kyi phung po hrīḥdang pad+ma las 'dod chags rdo rje dmar po g.yas pad+ma/ dril bu dang slob ma'i 'du byed kyi phung po khaṃ dang ral gri las phrag dog rdo rje ljang gu g.yas ral gri/ rdor dril dang slob ma'i gzugs phung buṃ dang 'khor lo las gti mug rdo rje dkar po g.yas 'khor lo dang g.yon rnams dril bu 'dzin pa/ phyag rgya drug gis brgyan cing g.yas brkyang gis bzhengs pa'i pang du rang 'dra'i yum gri thod 'dzin pa/ phyag rgya lngas spras pas 'khyud pa'i gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan pa'i 'od zer dang*/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa dang dbang lha spyan drangs/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa dam tshig pa la thim gnyis su med par gyur/ dbang gi lhar/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang lhas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes bum chus dbang bskur sku gang*/ dri ma dag /chu lhag ma las rang rigs kyi bdag po so sos dbu brgyan/ dbang lha rnams dbang rdzas kyi lha la thim zhing*/ dbang rdzas kyi lha rnams yab yum snyoms 'jug gi bde bas zhu ba dbang rdzas so so'i rnam par gyur/ slar yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas pa dbang lha gdan gsum tshang ba'i rnam par mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis slob ma la dbang bskur du gsol/

zhes slob dpon gyis gsol ba btab pas/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor pa rnams dang*/ spyan drangs pa'i dbang lha rgyal ba rnams kyis dbang gi dgongs pa mdzad/ yum rnams kyis dbang rdzas so sor bsnams nas dbang bskur/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis shis pa brjod cing me tog gtor/ sems ma rnams kyis slob ma'i steng phyogs su gdugs dang*/ rgyal mtshan/ ba dan la sogs pa 'dzin cing glu gar mdzad/ khro bo khro mo rnams kyis phyogs mtshams srung zhing bgegs bskrad bzhin par gyur par bsam/ rnam rgyal thogs nas/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni// khams gsum pa yis phyag byas pa// rdo rje'i gsang ba gsum byung ba// sangs rgyas kun gyis sbyin par bya// oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ tsakra bī ra s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ su ra te s+t+waṃ a haṃ/ zhes bum pa mgor bzhag / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes bum chu mgor blug cing 'thung du gzhug / de ltar bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bas lus gang*/ dri ma dag /chu lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil ba las/ mtshog mar mi bskyod pas rgyas btab| dbu rgyan thogs nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra dhā twī shwa ri a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta satwa badz+rī a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rat+na badz+rī a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pad+ma badz+rī a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta karma badz+rī a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/

zhes mgo'i dbus/ mdun/ g.yas/ rgyab/ g.yon lngar gtug / oṃ āḥbadz+ra mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa trāṃ/ zhes dbang bskur/ oṃ badz+ra tu ṣ+ya hoḥ zhes mnyes par bya/ oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥ.a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ zhes dar dpyangs bcings/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes chu dbang bskur/ de ltar bum chus dbang bskur bas lus gang*/ dri ma dag /chu lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil ba las/ mtshog mar rin chen 'byung ldan gyis rgyas btab/ rdo rje thogs nas/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje yi// dbang gi de ring khyod dbang bskur| |'di de sangs rgyas thams cad nyid// rab tu 'grub phyir rdo rje zung*// oṃ āḥbadz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes snying mgrin dpral bar gtug /lag g.yas su sbyin/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes chu dbang bskur/ de ltar bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bas lus gang*/ dri ma dag /chu lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil ba las/ mtshog mar 'od dpag med kyis rgyas btab/ dril bu thogs nas/ oṃ/ dril bu rdo rje dang ldan pa// shin tu dpa' bo nyid dbang bskur// rdo rje dam tshig gnas pa khyod// bdag po'i dbang bskur rgyal mnos shig /oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti twaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes mgor bzhag /lag g.yon du gtad/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes chu dbang bskur/ de ltar bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bas lus gang*/ dri ma dag /chu lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil ba las/ mtshog mar don yod grub pas rgyas btab/ rdor dril mnyam por thogs nas/ rdo rje ming gi dbang bskur bas// rtag pa'i rdo rje rab zhugs te// mi shigs rdo rje'i ming ldan par// bu khyod de ring dbang bskur bgyi// oṃ badz+ra satwa twaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ badz+ra nā ma a bhi ṣe ka ta/ kye dpal zhes bos nas/ me tog gang phog gi rigs kyi ming gdags/

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes chu dbang bskur/ de ltar bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bas lus gang*/ dri ma dag /chu lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil ba las/ mtshog mar rnam par snang mdzad kyis rgyas btab/ spyan drangs pa'i dbang lha rnams slob ma'i ba spu'i bu ga nas bcug la bstims/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ sngags kyi dbang bskur ye shes che// dngos grub ster ba bdag la stsol// ces gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ slob dpon 'khor lo sdom par gsal ba'i thugs kar nyi steng hūm̐ la sngags rnams kyis bskor ba las sngags phreng gnyis pa rnams so sor spros/ slob ma lhar gsal ba'i rna ba g.yon par brgyud/ snying gar nyi steng hūm̐ gi mthar bskor bar bsam/ yab yum gyi rtsa sngags snying po nye snying*/ mkha' 'gro ma bzhi'i sngags rnams rjes zlos lan gsum bya/ bcom ldan bdag gis gzung lags kyi// bdag la nye bar mdzad du gsol// zhes slob mas brjod/ slob dpon gyis/ bcom ldan 'di la bstsal lags kyi// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol// phrin las rdzogs par mdzad du gsol// zhes me tog 'thor/ des ma rig pa'i gnyen po nus pa nyid du sgrub par byed pa rig pa'i dbang lnga thob/ gtang rag dbul/ slob dpon gyi dbang la maṇ+ḍal dbul/ 'khor lo phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang*// mgon pos bdag la bstsal nas ni// 'khor lo lha yi de nyid dang*// slob dpon phrin las yongs su gsung*// zhes gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ dam tshig gsum sbyin pa ni/ slob ma skad cig gis dpal he ru kar bskyed rdo rje hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje sems dpa' de zhu ba las byung ba rdo rjer mos pa/ oṃ ma hā badz+ra hūm̐/ zhes lag g.yas su gtad/ dril bu aḥlas yum rdo rje snyems ma/ de zhu ba las byung dril bur mos la/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ṭa hoḥ zhes g.yon par gtad/

yid kyi las ni brtan bya'i phyir// phyag rgya'i dam tshig rab tu brjod// gang gi lus ni thams cad brtan// des na phyag rgyar rab tu grags// ye shes phyag rgyar byin brlabs nas// 'dod pa thams cad bsgrub par bya// zhes brjod/ slob ma 'khor lo sdom par gsal ba'i pang du rig ma rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba la/ kha sbyor gyi rim pas byin gyis brlabs te 'khyud pa la/ rlung kha sbyor gyis reg pa'i bde ba nyams su myong ba de nyid bum dbang gi ngo bor ngo sprod/ brtan phyir/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gis 'od kyis dbang lha spyan drangs/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ gsol ba btab pas/ dbang lhas bum pa bsnams nas/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyis// skye bas thob pa'i dbang bskur ba// ji ltar de bzhin bdag gis te// dag pa lha yi chu dbang bskur// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ de ltar bum chus dbang bskur sku gang*/ dri ma dag /chu lhag ma gyen du 'khyil ba las rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan| dbang lha rnams slob ma'i lus la bstims/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ me tog 'thor/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ rang gi sems nyid snang phyogs thabs bde ba chen po ni dpal he ru kaḥ stong phyogs shes rab rnam kun mchog ldan ni yum rdo rje phag mo/ de'i rang snang ma 'gag pa las mkha' 'gro ma la sogs bzhi dang*/ de dag gi rang rtsal phyogs med du shar ba ni gzhal yas khang bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas par snang ba ste/ de yang phyi snod bcud kyi 'jig rten/ nang phung khams skye mched/ rtsa thig rlung gsum/ gzhan dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rnam gsum ngo bo dbyer med gdod nas yongs su grub pa yin no// zhes dag pa brjod/ rdo rje che dang dril bu che// zung zhig rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs// de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur// slob ma bsdu ba nyid du gyis// zhi rgyas dbang dgug bsad pa dang*// bskrad dbye rmongs rengs grub pa brgyad// phan gnod las kun sgrub pa gyis// lus dang srog la mi lta bar// dam tshig thams cad srung bar gyis// dgun zla 'bring po nas brtsams te// tshes bcu la ni de rab mchod//

ces rjes gnang rnams sbyin/ mtha' rten rdo rje'i brtul zhugs ni/ slob ma skad cig gis rdo rje 'chang du mos la/ rdo rje gtad de/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad nyid// rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*// phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa s+t+waṃ dha ra yā mi badz+ra satwa hiḥ hi hi hi hi hūm̐/ zhes lag g.yas su gtad la/ des kyang smin mtshams su lan gsum gsor zhing snying gar bzung*/ des ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor mthong*/ bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus tha mal du 'dzin pa'i snang zhen gyi dri ma sbyangs/ lam bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang*/ dam tshig nyer bzhi bsrung*/ sprul sku'i sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag /'bras bu sku rdo rje 'grub pa'i skal ldan du byas so// gtang rag dbul/ gsang dbang la maṇ+ḍal dbul/ khyod kyi zhabs kyi bka' drin gyis// bdag gis bla med byang chub thob// de ring gsang ba'i dbang gis ni// mgon pos rjes su gzung du gsol// slob ma'i gdong bcings/ slob dpon he ru ka dang*/ rig ma phag mor gsal ba mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs/ snyoms par zhugs pa'i gsang rdzas dkar dmar 'dres pa slob ma gsung rdo rje gsal ba'i khar sbyin zhing*/ btung ba rin chen 'di yis ni// rdo rje yi ni lus 'grub par// bu khyod kyis ni shes kyis la// yid las byung ba'i chu 'thung zhig /oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces sbyin/ slob mas/ a hoḥm hā su khaṃ/ zhes brjod la btung*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mig dbye/ de ltar gsang rdzas myangs pas rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog pa 'gags nas/ bde drod kyi zung 'jug 'bar 'dzag gi rkyen gyis zhu bde lhan skyes thig le gsum gyi ye shes mngon du byas pa ni gsang dbang gi ngo bo yin no// zhes ngo sprad/ mtha' rten lung bstan ni|

slob dpon sprul sku'i cha lugs kyis g.yon snam sbyar gyi grwa snying gar bzung*/ g.yas skyabs sbyin bstan la/ oṃ/ 'dir ni khyod la ngas lung bstan// 'khor lo sdom pa'i de bzhin gshegs// srid pa shin tu dag pa'i phyir// srid dang ngan 'gro las khyod 'das// kye dpal gsang mtshan bos la/ nā ma ta thā ga ta sid+dhi sa ma ya s+t+waṃ bhurbahu waḥswaḥ gang ngas lung bstan pa ltar dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams dang phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad kyis kyang mgrin gcig tu lung ston par mdzad de/ de ni sngags dang phyag rgya 'di'i mthu yin no// zhes brjod/ des gsang ba bha ga'i dkyil 'khor mthong*/ des gsang dbang thob/ ngag las rlung gi dri ma dag /lam bdag byin rlabs dang*/ tsaṇ+ḍa lī dang*/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ dam tshig sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga bsten/ longs sku'i sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag /'bras bu gsung rdo rje 'grub pa'i skal ldan du byas so// gtang rag dbul/ sher dbang la maṇ+ḍal dbul/ bcom ldan zhi ba dga' chen po// rdo rje rnal 'byor gcig bzhed pa// mi phyed phyag rgya sgrub pa po// rdo rje sbyor las yang dag byung*// ji ltar khyod ni bdag nyid che// mnga' bdag bdag la'ang de ltar mdzod// 'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang du// bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs// gsum gsol/ gdong bcings/ rig ma gtad la/ lha mo dga' sbyin gnas sbyin ma// sna tshogs gzugs can yid 'ong ma// khyer cig khyer cig sems dpa' che// khyer la mchod pa rtag tu gyis// zhes gtad/ slob ma 'khor lo sdom pa dang*/ rig ma rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i yab kyi gsang ba hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar ham̐'u las nor bu oṃ bu ga phaṭa ser pos bkag pa/ yum gyi mkha' pad+ma 'dab brgyad dmar po'i lte bar baṃ dang*/ ze'u 'brur aṃ/ rtsa hrīḥyig dmar pos bkag pa/

yab yum lha/ mkha' gsang yig 'bru sngags/ thabs 'dis bde chen ye shes mngon du byed pa chos kyi 'du shes te/ 'du shes sum ldan gyi ngang nas dga' ba dang*/ 'khyud pa dang*/ 'o byed pa dang*/ pad+mar bcug cing bsrubs pa dang bsrub pa'i sbyor bas byang sems spyi bo nas mgrin par slebs pa dga' ba/ snying gar mchog dga'/ lte bar dga' bral/ gsang bar lhan skyes ngos bzung*/ nor bu'i rtse mor son pa na hūm̐ zhes rlung gi stobs kyis 'pho med du bcings/ gyen du ldog tshe lugs ldog gi dga' ba bzhi la bslabs| mig dar bsal/ de ltar las rgya la brten nas lus thams cad bde bas khyab cing*/ bde ba'i ngo bo stong par snang ba zung du 'jug pa rjes chags dpe'i ye shes mngon du byas pa ni sher dbang gi ngo bo yin no// zhes ngo sprad/ mtha' rten spyod pa'i brtul zhugs ni/ kha ṭ+wāṃ/ ḍā ru/ thod pa/ tshangs skud rnams bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las dbang rdzas rnams 'khor lo sdom pa yab yum mngon rtogs ltar bskyed la/ yongs su gyur pa las dbang rdzas so so'i rnam par gyur/ he ru ka yi phyag rgya 'di// phyi dang nang du yang dag gnas// kha ṭ+wāṃ cang te'u dung chen dang*// dpa' bos mchod phyir thogs bcas pa// byin pa dpa' bos gzung bar gyis// zhes slob ma'i lag g.yas su cang te'u/ g.yon du thod pa/ se ral khar tshangs skud/ mchan khung g.yon du kha ṭ+wāṃ gtad la| kha ṭ+wāṃ ga lha'i sku bde ba chen po/ ḍā ma ru shes rab stong pa nyid/ thod pa de gnyis 'dus pa'i bde ba skyong ba/ tshangs skud rnam par mi rtog pa'i don yin no// zhes brjod/ des kun rdzob byang sems kyi dkyil 'khor mthong*/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba thob/ yid thig le gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog rags pa'i dri ma dag /lam nor bu 'gengs pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ dam tshig phyag rgya bzhi gang rung dang 'bral bar mi bya/

chos sku'i sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag /'bras bu thugs rdo rje 'grub pa'i skal ldan du byas so// gtang rag dbul/ tshig dbang la maṇ+ḍal dbul/ khyod zhabs pad+mo spangs nas ni// gtso bo gzhan du ma mchis pas// de ring rin chen bzhi pa che// tshig gi dbang bskur bdag la stsol// gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ gdong dar ma bcing yang rung bcings kyang rung*/ slob dpon gyis/ rigs kyi bu khyod rig ma dang dbang po gnyis sprod snyoms par 'jug pa'i tshe/ gnyis shor gnyis mnyam dga' ba bzhi'i tha mar byang sems nor bur brtan pa'i tshe bde ba'i rang bzhin stong pa dang zung du 'jug pa brjod pa'i yul dang dper bya kun las 'das pa rnam rtog phra rags kyi dri ma thams cad dang bral ba nam mkha' lta bu de ni 'od gsal don dam pa'i bden pa yin la/ de'i rtsal snang ma 'gag pa las rlung sems tsam las phyi nang gzhan gsum dbyer med me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar med bzhin snang ba de ni sgyu lus kun rdzob kyi bden pa yin la/ de gnyis tsan+dan dang de'i dri ltar de las de skyes pa yang min la/ 'bral du yang med pa/ gcig med na cig shos kyang med pa| so sor dbyer med cing*/ gcig tu byas pa yang ma yin la/ phra zhing rtogs dka' ba/ dri mas gos ma myong ba/ gdod ma'i gshis lugs bcos ma'i rtog brtags kyis ma bslad pa| rang babs/ rang gshis/ rang shar/ rang grol/ rang mthong*/ rang rtogs su byas pa 'di ni zung du 'jug pa ste/ yan lag bdun dang ldan pa'i chos sku/ ma 'dres pa'i chos bco brgyad gdod nas rdzogs pa yin pa la yin par shes par gyis la/ de dag gi don ma bskyur bar sgom zhing phyag rgya bzhi'i lam gyis bogs thon par byos shig /des na spros bral lhan skyes zung 'jug nges pa don gyi ye shes sgro skur thams cad kyis stong pa/ bsal bzhag dang bral ba gang yin de nyid dbang bzhi pa'i ngo bo yin no//

zhes ngo sprad/ de nas mtha' rten dbugs dbyung gzengs bstod ni/ khyod dkyil 'khor 'dir zhugs mthong dbang bskur ba thob pa tsam gyis srid pa shin tu dag pa'i byang chub chen por gyur pa yin no// des don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor mthong*/ dbang bzhi pa thob/ sgo gsum du 'dzin pa'i dri ma phra ba dang*/ ye shes kyi dri ma gzung 'dzin der snang ches phra ba bag nyal dang bcas pa dag /lam phyag rgya chen po bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ dam tshig ni/ dgongs te gsungs pa bzhi bsrung*/ ngo bo nyid kyi sku'i sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag /'bras bu ye shes rdo rje 'grub pa'i skal ldan du byas so// zhes don bshad/ gtang rag dbul/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo ni/ thabs kyi rdzas bza' ba g.yas/ shes rab kyi rdzas btung ba g.yon/ mnyam rol gyi rdzas g.yos sbyar dbus su bzhag |lag pa g.yon nang mchod kyis dag par byas pa'i mthil du dri'i thig le'am/ 'bru tshoms lnga bkod la bsangs sbyangs/

stong pa'i ngang las lag mthil pad+ma 'dab ma lnga pa'i lte bar oṃ baṃ/ mdun nas g.yon skor du| haṃ yoṃ/ hrīṃ moṃ/ hriṃ hrīṃ/ huṃ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa rnams dang*/ mthe bong la oṃ ha/ mdzub mo la na ma hi/ gung mo la swā hā hu/ ming med la bau ṣaṭa he/ mthe'u chung la huṃ hūm̐ hoḥ sen mo rnams la phaṭa haṃ rnams dang*/ bol gong du lha lnga me long la snang brnyan shar ba lta bu/ lag pa'i sa chu me rlung nam mkha' ste/ khams lnga ltung byed ma sogs lngar gyur par mos/ oṃ baṃ/ haṃ yoṃ/ hrīṃ moṃ/ hriṃ hrīṃ/ huṃ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ ha/ na ma hi/ swā hā hu/ bau ṣaṭa he/ huṃ hūm̐ hoḥ phaṭa haṃ/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ḍā ki nī dzā la sam+ba raṃ swā hā| oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ḍā ki nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ lā me huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro he huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ| oṃ rū pi ṇī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces nang mchod thigs gtor dang sha zan dbul/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ rkang brgyad gnyis kyis bstod/ thal mo sbyar ba spyi bor bzhag nas/ lag pa'i lha rnams rang nyid la thim par bsam/ tshogs rdzas bsangs sbyangs/ byin rlabs nang mchod ltar byas nas/ phud dkyil 'khor du 'bu+ul zhing*/ hūm̐ */ bde chen 'khor lo'i gnas mchog nas// rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang*// rab 'byams zhing khams rgya mtsho nas// brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa'i tshogs// 'og min bde chen zhing khams nas// bcom ldan khrag 'thung bde ba'i mchog /mkha' spyod dag pa'i pho brang nas| |rgyal yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// phyogs bzhir rab yangs pho brang nas/ */bde chen 'khor lo'i ḍā ki bzhi// sa 'og sa steng sa bla nas// sku gsung thugs kyi 'khor lo gsum// grong dang dur khrod gnas brgyad nas// dam tshig 'khor lo 'jigs pa'i tshogs// phyi nang gzhan gsum gnas yul nas// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i tshogs// dur khrod chen po'i gnas mchog nas// dpal mgon nag po bran dang bcas// 'bri gdan byang chub gling mchog nas// bstan srung chos kyi sgrol ma sogs// rtsa gsum zhi khro'i lha tshogs rnams// rnal 'byor gdung bas spyan 'dren gyi// thugs dam gnyan po nyer dgongs la// mkha' la glog bzhin 'dir gshegs te// dam rdzas thabs shes ga ṇa'i rdzas// ting 'dzin zas mchog 'di la rol| |dngos grub rnam gnyis bstsal du gsol// kye/

tshogs khang pho brang gnas kyi mchog /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro grogs kyi mchog /dam rdzas rgya mtsho zas kyi mchog /dur khrod rol mo sgra yi mchog /bsam du med pa'i ting 'dzin mchog /gzhom med nā da sngags kyi mchog /gdod nas grub pa lha yi mchog /kun kyang byin rlobs gzi byin skyed// brda dang gar gyis rab mtshon nas// gsang sngags 'dod yon tshogs la rol// a la la ste dgyes par mdzod// ces brjod/ kha na ma tho ba spangs la tshogs la longs spyod/ lhag ma bsdus par slob dpon gyis chang kha brus btab la/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma ṇāṃ ād+ya nut+pan+na twāta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ gsum dang*/ kye/ dpal chen khrag 'thung bka' nyan pa// zhing skyong phra men 'byung po ging*// lha mi'i bdag po gtso dang 'khor| |rdo rje bran g.yog dpung tshogs bcas// dam tshig brda yis 'dir 'bod kyi// gshegs shig dam rdzas lhag rol bzhes// dam tshig can gyi grogs mdzod cig /dam nyams rnams kyi gshed mdzod cig /bcol ba'i las kun myur du sgrubs// oṃ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa bhak+ṣe bh+yaḥswā hā/ zhes dbul/ bum mdun gyi lha la chu bzhi nyer spyod rol mos mchod/ rkang pa brgyad pa gnyis kyi bstod/ yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang*/ rim gnyis zab mo bsgoms 'dis bdag la ni// zhes sogs sngar bshad pa ltar smon lam btab/ oṃ/ badz+ra muḥ mdun bskyed dang bum bskyed kyi ye shes pa rnams gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ shis brjod ci rigs pa bya/ dkyil 'khor sogs bsdu zhing las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// sdom pa'i sgrub dkyil rgya gar mkhas pa'i lugs// rgyu skar ji bzhin bgrang yas mchis pa'i dbus// gtum po'i 'od ltar 'gran bral snying po ni// mar me mdzad dpal bzhed 'di nges par mthong*// de slad bdag gzhan kun la phan pa'i blos// bris 'di sa 'og gter bzhin ma gyur par// kun gyis nyams su len pa'i rgyur gyur cing*| |de dge 'gro kun sangs rgyas thob phyir bsngo// bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lha lnga'i sgrub dkyil mar me mdzad dpal ye shes kyi zhal gyi lung zhes bya ba 'di ni/

jo bo chen pos mdzad pa'i bde mchog lha bcu gsum ma dang*/ lha lnga dang*/ dpa' gcig gi sgrub thabs dang*/ gtor ma'i cho ga rnams paṇ+ḍi ta de nyid dang*/ lo tsā ba rin chen bzang pos bsgyur ba kho na gzhir bzhag /gtor chog gi skabs slob dpon rtag pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i gtor chog nas cung zad kha bskangs/ mchod pa byin rlabs dang*/ sngon 'gro'i gtor ma dang*/ bzlas pa'i snga rol gyi mchod bstod dang*/ bum mdun dbang*/ tshogs 'khor rnams mi rung ba ma yin par bsams pas kha bskangs/ de las gzhan pa'i rgya gzhung dang bod ma gang gis kyang bsre lhad tshig zur tsam yang ma bgyis par/ rtsod dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa/ ār+ya swa mi dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na zhes snyan grags srid rtser 'phyo ba de nyid kyi gsung bzhin/ 'bri gung pa chos kyi grags pas shing bya chu stod can snga ma'i dmar po'i rgyal ba gnyis par rtse ba gzhis ka sra brtan rdo rje'i gnas mchog tu sbyar ba 'dis sems can thams cad dpal he ru ka'i go 'phang thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ //maṅga laṃ//
